A ready post can\'t be changed. To change it, take it back to draft, then mark it ready again.
The post can\'t be ready yet. The reasons are shown above “Ready”.
Only a ready post can do that.
Pick a channel to post to.
The post has neither text nor a picture.
The post is %1$s characters long; the channel takes %2$s. Links count as 23, the content warning counts too.
The post has %1$s pictures; the channel takes %2$s.
The channel only takes posts with a picture.
Picture %1$s is %2$s MB; the channel takes up to %3$s MB.
The alt text of picture %1$s is %2$s characters long; the channel takes %3$s.
The channel doesn\'t take content warnings.
%1$s isn\'t a placeholder anything fills in, so it would be posted as written.
The link may name whoever shared it.
